purpose: IESVE-compatible transport conversion; not a normative SIA compliance result.

conversion.hour_interpretation: TMY1 hour-ending; solar geometry at midpoint
conversion.diffuse_radiation_method: DHI=max(0,GHI-DNI*cos(zenith)); DNI capped to preserve GHI

limitations: The TMY1 source lacks diffuse horizontal radiation for this dataset; DHI is reconstructed for EPW interoperability.
The generated EPW must be opened and read back through IESVE WeatherFileReader before model mutation.
Official/certification use still requires approval of source provenance and the SIA-authorized test procedure.
